_about: Libraries a deck may pull in instead of hand-building a UI element. All are no-build browser files, pinned to exact versions on jsDelivr; bundle.mjs inlines them so a bundled deck works offline. Add with scripts/add-lib.mjs. Usage notes: references/libraries.md.

libs.name: Alpine.js
libs.use: Make a mockup actually work: forms that validate, lists you can add to and filter, toggles, totals that update, tabs with real content (x-data, x-model, x-for, x-show).

libs.name: SortableJS
libs.use: Drag to reorder: kanban boards, sortable lists, moving cards between columns, touch-friendly.

libs.name: Chart.js
libs.use: Charts inside app screens that respond to hover and taps (tooltips, legends you can click), or chart types data-chart lacks: radar, scatter, bubble, mixed bar and line.

libs.name: Apache ECharts
libs.use: Dense dashboards and specialist charts: gauges, sankey, treemap, heatmap, funnel, calendar heatmap, candlestick, graph networks.

libs.name: D3
libs.use: A one-off custom visualization no chart library draws (force layouts, custom maps, animated explainers).

libs.name: flatpickr
libs.use: A working date or date-range picker, or an inline calendar (bookings, scheduling, trip planning).

libs.name: Tom Select
libs.use: Searchable dropdowns, tag and multi-select inputs, autocomplete.

libs.name: Grid.js
libs.use: A data table that really searches, sorts and pages (admin screens, reports, CRM lists).

libs.name: Swiper
libs.use: Swipeable carousels: onboarding screens, image galleries, card stacks, with dots and momentum.

libs.name: Leaflet
libs.online: Map tiles load from the internet; offline the map is blank behind its markers.
libs.use: A real pan-and-zoom map with pins, routes and areas (store finders, delivery, travel, field teams).

libs.name: Mermaid
libs.use: Diagrams written as text: flowcharts, sequence, state, ER, class, user journey, gantt, mind maps, architecture.
libs.gotcha: Don't give a diagram class="mermaid": Mermaid renders those itself at page load while their slide is hidden and they come out tiny. Use class="diagram" and mermaid.render() inside deck.mount, with startOnLoad: false and solid colors (ctx.solid).

libs.name: highlight.js
libs.use: Syntax highlighting for real code in code slides and in IDE or terminal mockups (190 languages).

libs.name: KaTeX
libs.use: Typeset math: formulas, equations, proofs (lectures, research, finance models).

libs.name: xterm.js
libs.use: A real terminal for CLI and developer-tool demos: colored output, typed commands, progress bars.

libs.name: Lottie
libs.use: Play a Lottie animation (.json from After Effects or LottieFiles) the user supplies: illustrations, animated icons, success states.

libs.name: GSAP
libs.license: GSAP standard license (free, including commercial use)
libs.use: Choreographed motion beyond data-anim: timelines, Flip layout morphs inside a mockup, physics-like easing, scrubbed sequences.

libs.name: canvas-confetti
libs.use: A confetti burst for a launch, a milestone or a success screen in a demo.

libs.name: qrcode-generator
libs.use: A scannable QR code (try the app, download the deck, join the waitlist), drawn crisp at any size.

libs.name: Pico CSS (scoped)
libs.use: Good-looking native form controls, tables, switches, sliders, accordions and dialogs inside a web-app mockup, by adding class="pico" to the mockup's screen. Styles nothing outside .pico.
